speaker: caller
text: Good afternoon, this is the fraud prevention unit calling about your bank account.

speaker: receiver
text: Oh, hello? What is this about?

speaker: caller
text: We detected a credit card opened under your NRIC that was used for money laundering.

speaker: receiver
text: What? I never opened any card. Are you sure?

speaker: caller
text: I understand. Because this is a serious case, I will transfer you to the Singapore Police Force now.

speaker: caller
text: I am Inspector Tan from the Singapore Police Force, badge number two zero four seven.

speaker: caller
text: Your name is linked to a criminal case and you may be arrested today if you do not cooperate.

speaker: receiver
text: I didn't do anything. What do I need to do?

speaker: caller
text: You must not tell anyone, not your family and not your bank. This investigation is confidential.

speaker: caller
text: To prove your innocence, we need to check your funds. Transfer your savings into a safety account that we provide.

speaker: receiver
text: Transfer my savings? Is that really okay?

speaker: caller
text: Do it right now, within the next thirty minutes, or a warrant will be issued.

speaker: caller
text: Open your banking app and send all the money to this account number. Read me the OTP when the bank sends it.

speaker: receiver
text: I'm scared. Let me find my phone.

speaker: caller
text: Stay on the line. Do not hang up until the transfer is done.
